subject: Request: compact cryptographic controls sampling plan + SOC 2 appendix
messages:
From: Alice Yang <alice.yang@finserv-co.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finserv-co.com, Procurement <procurement@finserv-co.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compact sampling plan request for SOC 2 appendix — KMS/HSM artifacts

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of FinServ Co.'s SOC 2 readiness checklist, our security team needs a compact, exportable sampling package that demonstrates your encryption and key management controls. To keep the scope manageable we are asking for a sampling bundle that covers:

- At-rest encryption: confirmation of KMS provider(s), algorithm families, and example CMK metadata
- HSM attestation: vendor statement (FIPS/CC), operator separation, and one attestation PDF
- Rotation evidence: a short rotation-log extract (CSV) showing a rotation event and operator IDs
- Transit protections: TLS versions and cipher suite statements for inter-service and ingress traffic

Can you provide a concise "sampling plan" PDF and the three sample artifacts noted above? Our auditors prefer small, self-contained bundles (1–3MB each) and a one‑page mapping that ties the artifacts back to SOC 2 control IDs.

Target timeline: would you be able to deliver by Tue Nov 10th COB? If not, please propose an alternate date. We may request a short walkthrough call with your ops lead after review.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Yang
Security Program Manager, FinServ Co.
phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Yang <alice.yang@finserv-co.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact sampling plan request for SOC 2 appendix — KMS/HSM artifacts

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We can assemble a compact bundle and will include a one‑page mapping to SOC 2 control criteria. Quick notes:

- We will include a trimmed HSM attestation (redacted operator names) and a sanitized rotation log extract.
- We'll provide the KMS configuration snapshot and accompanying algorithm/cipher table.
- Transit statement will be a short appendix that lists TLS minimum versions and mutual-TLS exceptions (if any).

Ben and Jonas, can you coordinate the artifacts and a short sampling plan PDF? Target Nov 10 COB for upload to FinServ's secure folder; if we need to redact anything beyond operator IDs we should flag it to Alice.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(925) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-compact-sampling-plan.pdf (draft placeholder)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact sampling plan request for SOC 2 appendix — KMS/HSM artifacts

Marissa / Jonas — taking point on the sampling artifacts. Implementation notes and what I'll include in the bundle: 

1) HSM attestation:
   - Vendor: SafeVault HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3, vendor attestation statement attached).
   - Content: certificate snapshot + attestation PDF; redaction applied to internal operator usernames.

2) Rotation log extract (rotation-log-sample.csv):
   - Single rotation event (2026-10-12 03:21:10 UTC) with operator_id (hashed), KEK id, and confirmation of rewrap action.
   - I will include a short readme describing hashing/salting approach to protect operator identities.

3) KMS config snapshot:
   - Primary provider: Redwood KMS (HSM-backed), secondary: AWS KMS (external cross‑region replica).
   - Algorithms: AES-256-GCM for data keys, RSA-4096 for wrapping where used.

4) Transit note:
   - Ingress TLS: TLS 1.3 enforced for public ingress, internal service mesh uses mTLS with TLS1.3; accepted cipher suites listed in appendix.

I will prepare the three files and the compact sampling plan PDF (1 page + TOC) and upload to the SharePoint link Marissa provided, then notify Alice. Please review the draft attestation for redactions before upload.

Ben Carter
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: rotation-log-sample.csv, hsm-attestation-statement.pdf

From: Alice Yang <alice.yang@finserv-co.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finserv-co.com, Procurement <procurement@finserv-co.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact sampling plan request for SOC 2 appendix — KMS/HSM artifacts

Marissa / Ben — excellent, this looks straightforward. Thank you for the detail. A few quick items from our side before you upload:

- Auditor preference: please include a CSV column that maps the rotation-log event to the canonical key id (not full material) and the SOC 2 control ID reference.
- For the HSM attestation PDF, our auditors prefer the vendor-signed statement; redaction of operator usernames is fine but please retain unique operator hashes so they can sample.
- SharePoint upload is fine; we will provision a short-lived folder (link below). After upload we will schedule a 30‑minute walkthru next week with our external auditor (Nov 12 or 13 preferred).

SharePoint (upload folder): https://finserv-co.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/finserv-security/CompactEvidence/ES2uQ1

If anything needs exec‑level signoff for redaction please flag and loop in our procurement contact.

Best,
Alice

Attachments: none
